correctness.rationale: For the exact nearest-origin signed unit steps u_n=e^{2πipn/q}, ties terminate by convention. For q=1,2 the one-dimensional real greedy displacement converges to a 2-cycle; for q=4 alternating orthogonal coordinate directions yield a 4-cycle. For q=3,6, each q-block obeys |Z_q|²−|Z|²≤q²−2 c_q|Z| with c_3=√3 and c_6=2√3. On a fixed fractional Eisenstein lattice, strict radius decline cannot persist indefinitely outside the resulting threshold; the block-start disks of radii 6 and 12 are absorbing and forward invariant. In Eisenstein fractional coordinates, three affine sign families cut the closed unit square into exactly 10 faces, 19 edges and 10 vertices. Uniform bounds on trapped integer offsets imply a complete rational finite search over 39*(17²+31²)=48,750 stratum/offset starts. Independently constructed a distinct exact-Fraction checker of the line arrangement and all block return maps: q3 11,271 starts and q6 37,479 starts; both have period-set histogram 24 strata {3,6}, 11 strata {3}, four strata {6}, and no other nonterminating recurrent block period. The supplied complete verifier additionally provides strict period-3 and period-6 rational witnesses. These exact finite checks, together with the analytical absorbing argument, cover all initial points without unjustified finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The original Steinerberger–Zeng paper investigates rotating greedy signed walks mainly with irrational angles and conditional periodic sign words. Its irrationality hypotheses and sign-period implications do not yield unconditional position-periodicity at rational crystallographic denominators. The later Albors et al model uses random or van-der-Corput directions rather than q-periodic roots of unity. Resultary searches found no stronger complete position-period classification for q in {1,2,3,4,6}; best of knowledge PASS, allowing unindexed rational-angle follow-ups as residual risk.
residual_risks: A later unindexed follow-up may classify crystallographic rational directions as a special case under a different sign-map convention.
The exceptional stopping convention at exact ties is essential; no claim applies to terminated walks.
39-sign-stratum exhaustive calculation depends critically on the proved uniform absorbing disk and on correct lattice offset bounds.

value.rationale: Exact global dynamics of a natural greedy walk is mathematically nontrivial because phase-dependent threshold choices and unbounded initial positions can generate long transients. The crystalline Eisenstein lattice trapping, closed exact 39-stratum census, and sharp full least-position period spectrum supply a motivated complete classification for precisely the rational rotations compatible with planar crystallographic directions.

limitations: Excludes terminating tie trajectories by definition; classifies eventual position periods, not sign period or capture time
